# Outcomes

Asking which channel a native fallible `T ! E` holds without unwrapping it.

<h2 id="succeeded"><code>Succeeded&lt;T, E&gt;</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Succeeded<T, E>(outcome: T ! E) -> bool
```

Whether `outcome` holds a success.
`outcome` is consumed; its payload is destroyed after the question is answered. Runs in constant time and
allocates nothing.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Core/Src/Outcome.rux#L17)

**Type parameters**

| Name | Description      |
| ---- | ---------------- |
| `T`  | the success type |
| `E`  | the error type   |

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type    | Description         |
| --------- | ------- | ------------------- |
| `outcome` | `T ! E` | the fallible to ask |

**Returns**: whether it holds a success
